name: Antipode-Neighborhood-Deleted Cube Contraction Obstructions
definition: $\mathcal U_{d,r}=2^{[d]}\setminus(\{\varnothing,[d]\}\cup\{[d]\setminus\{i\}:1\le i\le r\})$: delete two antipodes and $r$ selected neighbors of the top antipode.
parameters: $d\ge4$ and $0\le r\le d$. It has $2^d-r-2$ states and isometric dimension $d$.
canonical_form: Cube automorphisms make the number $r$ of deleted co-singletons the only parameter once the antipodal deleted pair is fixed.
recognition: A deleted-state certificate identifies the antipodal pair and the $r$ deleted neighbors at one endpoint. Contracting a selected neighbor coordinate gives $Q_{d-1}$ with one vertex deleted; contracting any other coordinate gives $Q_{d-1}$.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. For $d=4$, the five values $0\le r\le4$ are the five local-closedness representatives described in the survey.
